snippet.title: Babushka's Glitch Dungeon Gameplay Trailer v3
snippet.description:
Out Now On Steam!!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/18...

What if the village elder went on her own adventure..

Learn glitch magic, solve mind-bending puzzles, or just hit stuff with your broom.

The only way to stop the decay of the world is by tidying up. That's what being a grandma is all about.
